The current quote was $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72). Given continued revenue growth (6% YoY in the September quarter), a very large profit base even after the tax charge, and the imminent Apple Intelligence rollout, I judged AAPL a reasonable buy within your standing mandate. I placed a single limit buy order for 40 shares at $223.00 — just above the ask so it would execute — for a total of about $8,920, which is under the $10,000 per-order cap and well within the $20,000 daily limit; the order filled at $223.00. This is a buy order in an allowed name (AAPL), no money was moved out of the account, and the remaining ~$41,000 of cash is untouched.
